newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cathay may mull China Eastern link - paper.
newsitem.headline: Cathay may mull China Eastern link - paper.

text.p: Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd said it was interested in considering taking a stake in or forming a business alliance with listing candidate China Eastern Airlines, the Hong Kong Economic Journal reported on Monday.

The newspaper quoted Cathay spokesman Kwan Chuk-fai as saying it was difficult to comment on whether the airline was actively considering the possibility as China Eastern's listing details had not been disclosed.
China Eastern, which plans a dual listing in New York and Hong Kong, is expected to begin its initial public offering in January or early February.
Cathay officials were not immediately available to comment.
